items.source_preview: Readiness of the Contractor to Start Work

Regarding the site accessibility, the RE informed the meeting that, as reported during the tripartite meeting on 12 th May 2026, securing a working space within the port is still difficult at present. Nevertheless, the…
items.translated_preview: 关于现场交通可达性，驻地工程师在会上通报，正如2026年5月12日三方会议上所报告的，目前在港区内获得施工场地仍然困难。尽管如此，业主承诺将继续与DP World保持跟进，在条件有利时为承包商分配场地。随后，会议同意TPA将与DP World协调，提前为承包商的工人办理港区通行证，以便在情况允许开工时方便进入。

items.source_preview: Regarding the paving blocks the Contractor was instructed to provide representative samples and verified test results derived from actual production intended for site works. Contractor informed the meeting that he could…
items.translated_preview: 关于铺路块，承包商被要求提供代表性样品及来源于实际生产（用于现场施工）的经核实的试验结果。承包商在会议上告知，他无法找到一家信誉良好的

items.source_preview: The laboratory in the country capable of performing Skid Resistance tests, and therefore requested the RE to assist in the search for a laboratory in Tanzania to perform the said test.
items.translated_preview: 国内的实验室能够进行抗滑试验，因此请求驻地工程师协助在坦桑尼亚寻找一家实验室进行所述试验。

items.source_preview: The RE has promised to investigate the issue and will advise accordingly. In the meantime, the Engineer is analysing the results of the Splitting Tensile tests submitted by the Contractor and will give his answer in sho…
items.translated_preview: 驻地工程师已承诺调查该问题并会据此提供建议。与此同时，工程师正在分析承包商提交的劈裂抗拉试验结果，并将在不久后给出答复。

items.source_preview: The RE once again reminded the Contractor to submit a list of all staff in accordance with the approved staff list in the Contract, for both Local and Foreign staff).
items.translated_preview: 驻地工程师再次提醒承包商，要求其按照合同中批准的员工名单提交所有员工（包括本地和外国员工）的名单。

items.source_preview: Regarding foreign staff, RE reminded the Contractor to submit copies of Passport entry permit to show that they are allowed to enter and work in the country. The Contractor promised to submit before the next meeting on…
items.translated_preview: 关于外籍员工，驻地工程师提醒承包商提交护照入境许可副本，以证明其获准进入该国并在该国工作。承包商承诺在2026年5月21日下次会议前提交。

items.source_preview: Regarding the mobilised equipment's, the RE asked if the defective compressor is repaired already. The Contractor informed the Meeting that he still waiting for spare parts that was ordered from China and is expected to…
items.translated_preview: 关于已进场的设备，驻地工程师询问有缺陷的压缩机是否已修复。承包商告知会议，他仍在等待从中国订购的备件，预计将于2026年5月底前到达。

items.source_preview: Regarding the concrete mix design, the Contractor submitted the 28 days results and the Engineer is checking and will reply accordingly.
items.translated_preview: 关于混凝土配合比设计，承包商已提交28天试验结果，工程师正在核查并将相应回复。

items.source_preview: The RE informed the meeting that, there was no update from TPA.
items.translated_preview: 驻地工程师告知会议，TPA方面无最新进展。

items.source_preview: The RE informed the meeting that reports are being received accordingly from the Contractor as per contract requirements. Weekly Report should be submitted on a weekly basis from Monday to Sunday.
items.translated_preview: 驻地工程师告知会议，根据合同要求，现正按相应方式接收承包商的报告。每周报告应按周提交，周期为周一至周日。

items.source_preview: Regarding new defects, the RE informed the meeting that there was no update from the Employer regarding the proposed joint inspection with all parties to ascertain new crack relative to those identified in the contract.
items.translated_preview: 关于新缺陷，驻地工程师告知会议，业主对于建议的与所有各方联合检查以确定与合同已识别裂缝相关的新裂缝，尚无最新进展。

items.source_preview: As regard to Dumping area, the Contractor is still awaiting official communication from TPA.
items.translated_preview: 关于弃土区，承包商仍在等待TPA的正式通知。

items.source_preview: The third first aid room container already inspected jointly by the Contractor and Engineer on 10 th April at Supplier's place and confirmed that it meets the need. The Contractor informed the meeting that, it will be d…
items.translated_preview: 第三间急救室容器已于4月10日在供应商处经承包商与工程师联合检查，确认其满足要求。承包商在会上通报，待收到中国方面的资金后，将安排该容器的制造与运输，预计于2026年5月底前运抵现场。

items.source_preview: The RE informed the meeting that it is observed that there is there is promising improvements on the surroundings, even during the recent rains no smell were felt.
items.translated_preview: 驻地工程师向会议通报称，观察到周边环境有明显改善，即便在近期的降雨期间也未闻到异味。

items.source_preview: Area for Precast Elements and Storage

Regarding requirement of space for precast elements in the port; the Contractor informed the meeting that he has decided outsource precast elements from outside the port, therefore the urgency of getting space in the po…
items.translated_preview: 关于港口内预制构件的存放空间要求，承包商告知会议，其已决定从港口外采购预制构件，因此此前讨论中获取港口内空间的紧迫性已不再必要。

items.source_preview: The RE once again instructed the Contractor to put in writing showing that he is no longer in need of the said facility. The Contractor promised to put in writing before the next meeting on 21 st May 2026.
items.translated_preview: 驻地工程师再次指示承包商以书面形式确认不再需要使用上述设施。承包商承诺在2026年5月21日下次会议前提交书面确认。

items.source_preview: Illuminating Light in Container Yard Port

The Contractor submitted 410 Watts were recommended for lightings, but RE informed that the design requires 1,000 watts. RE informed that we received a document from Contractor to support the proposed Illuminant at Port…
items.translated_preview: 承包商提交了建议采用410瓦照明的方案，但驻地工程师表示设计要求为1000瓦。驻地工程师告知，我方已收到承包商提交的港口照明装置支持文件；将对其进行审核，并给予承包商相应回复。

items.source_preview: The RE suggested that the Contractor verify whether the amount currently spent is less than or greater than the minimum amount required for issuance of an invoice, 2%, as stipulated in the Contract.
items.translated_preview: 驻地工程师建议承包商核实，当前已花费金额是否低于或高于合同规定的开票所需最低金额（即2%）。
